_howto: 1) python -m sidecar.midi_tap list  2) python -m sidecar.midi_tap watch --port 'X1 MK3'  3) move a control, note the printed ch/kind/#  4) add an entry: {"channel": 0, "kind": "cc", "number": 21, "label": "FX1 · Dry/Wet", "deck": "FX", "widget": "fx1_drywet"}. widget must match an id in layout.json (otherwise HUD-only). Optional "page": "fx" scopes the entry; register page switches in page_buttons.
